# BloomAbroad

> BloomAbroad is an independent enrolment readiness check for studying in Ireland. It assesses application readiness and immigration readiness, and an experienced consultant reviews every result. BloomAbroad is a trading name of Ubisphere Ltd, an Irish company based in Cork. It is not an agent and takes no commission.

BloomAbroad does not make admission, visa or immigration decisions, and no outcome guarantees one. Universities decide on admission; Ireland's immigration authorities decide on visa and immigration matters.

## Who it is for
- Students planning to study in Ireland, and their parents and sponsors
- Admissions and international offices at Irish universities and colleges (institution workspace in development)

## Key pages
- [For students and families](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/students): what the readiness check covers, how it works, FAQs
- [For universities](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/universities): enrolment readiness screening for international applications
- [Pricing](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/pricing): Readiness Assessment €30, Plus €65, founding prices, local prices in naira, shillings and cedis
- [Free Ireland Readiness Checklist](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/checklist): a free 2-minute quiz that returns a personal list of what to prepare. It is not an assessment
- [How to verify it's really us](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/verify): our only websites, email addresses and payment method
- [Contact](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/contact): hello@bloomabroad.ie for general questions, privacy@bloomabroad.ie for data requests
- [Privacy Notice](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/terms)
- [Complaints](https://bloomabroad.vercel.app/complaints)

## Outcomes
Ready to Apply · Needs Support · Not Yet in a Position to Apply. Results are issued within 5 working days of a complete set of answers and documents.

## Prices (euro; bookings open January 2027)
- Readiness Assessment: €30. Founding price for the first 100 waitlist members: €18
- Readiness Assessment Plus (adds a 30-minute consultant call): €65. Founding price: €39
- The price is the same whatever the outcome. 14-day right to cancel, as set out in the Terms.
